anchor.note: on the bank beside the ferry berth, not on it. The berth is the passage's first mark and lies in an 11 m cut; a room pinned there is a room under water.

maritime.note: Maritime navigates between DOCKS, not coordinates. Each dock carries its approach - the nearest point offshore where a hull of the stated draught floats, and the bearing to reach it. A dock's own position is at the waterline where depth is nearly zero, so a passage that starts there is never navigable: the first attempt at one produced two waypoints and gave up for exactly that reason.
